description: Exploratory critic-only LoRA-RL transfer on the original AMBI prior-only backbone: preserve the N512/H3/B512 step-interleaved SAC round sweep while replacing only critic adaptation with input-and-hidden rank-96 LoRA.

lora_step_rounds.description: Critic-only LoRA-RL rank96/input_hidden at direct scale1 and adapter decay2e-4; dense actor and all N512/H3/B512 step-round SAC settings remain unchanged. Reuse paired prior references.

j1.description: 1 inner rounds; 1536 imagined transitions and 3 critic/actor/automatic-temperature updates per real action. Fresh action-local adaptation; step timing, interval512, N512/H3/B512. Critic-only input-and-hidden rank-96 LoRA-RL; cloned actor, trainable value heads/biases/normalization, learned frozen bases and zero-B initialization.
